additional_info.subject: Customer query
additional_info.body:

A technician was already on site. Please find a solution to the problem as quickly as possible! Thank you very much.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377391-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313682017001] OCPP connection not stable CRM:00643000885
additional_info.body:
Hi Tanja,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs from yesterday and found multiple instances where the OCPP was disconnected briefly due to a network error. The router was connected via mobile, but the OCPP disconnections were not prolonged. This indicates that the SIM card issued by the network provider is not the problem, but rather a weak signal causing the disconnections. Upon reviewing the latest charger logs from the past 3 hours, we identified only one brief disconnection of the OCPP system. Apart from this isolated incident, the OCPP system remained stable.
If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Otherwise, we recommend closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
